mapper.select:
SELECT question_id AS questionId, exam_id AS examId, section_id AS sectionId, question_number AS questionNumber, question_type AS questionType, question_type_tag AS questionTypeTag, score, correct_answer AS correctAnswer, question_text AS questionText, passage, sort_order AS sortOrder
FROM exam_questions
WHERE exam_id = #{examId}
ORDER BY sort_order, question_number

SELECT q.question_id AS questionId, q.exam_id AS examId, q.section_id AS sectionId, q.question_number AS questionNumber, q.question_type AS questionType, q.question_type_tag AS questionTypeTag, q.score, q.correct_answer AS correctAnswer, q.question_text AS questionText, q.passage, q.sort_order AS sortOrder
FROM exam_answers a
JOIN exam_questions q ON a.question_id = q.question_id
WHERE a.attempt_id = #{attemptId} AND a.is_correct = FALSE
ORDER BY q.question_number

SELECT choice_id AS choiceId, question_id AS questionId, choice_number AS choiceNumber, choice_text AS choiceText, sort_order AS sortOrder
FROM exam_question_choices
WHERE question_id = #{questionId}
ORDER BY sort_order, choice_number

SELECT attempt_id, exam_id, student_id, attempt_no, attempt_type, source_attempt_id, entry_method, status, total_score, max_score, correct_count, total_question_count, started_at, submitted_at, graded_at
FROM exam_attempts
WHERE exam_id = #{examId} AND student_id = #{studentId} AND attempt_type = 'EXAM' AND status = 'GRADED'
ORDER BY attempt_id DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT attempt_id, exam_id, student_id, attempt_no, attempt_type, source_attempt_id, entry_method, status, total_score, max_score, correct_count, total_question_count, started_at, submitted_at, graded_at
FROM exam_attempts
WHERE exam_id = #{examId} AND student_id = #{studentId} AND attempt_type = #{attemptType} AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
ORDER BY attempt_id DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT a.attempt_id AS attemptId, a.exam_id AS examId,
e.title AS examTitle, e.exam_type AS examType,
a.attempt_type AS attemptType,
'EXAM' AS resultType,
a.total_score AS totalScore, a.max_score AS maxScore,
a.correct_count AS correctCount, a.total_question_count AS totalQuestionCount,
a.submitted_at AS submittedAt
FROM exam_attempts a
JOIN exams e ON a.exam_id = e.exam_id
WHERE a.student_id = #{studentId} AND a.status = 'GRADED'
ORDER BY a.submitted_at DESC, a.attempt_id DESC

SELECT *
FROM (
SELECT
a.attempt_id AS attemptId,
NULL AS dailyReviewAttemptId,
e.exam_id AS examId,
e.title AS examTitle,
a.attempt_type AS attemptType,
'EXAM' AS resultType,
e.exam_date AS resultDate,
a.total_score AS totalScore,
a.max_score AS maxScore,
a.correct_count AS correctCount,
a.total_question_count AS totalQuestionCount,
a.submitted_at AS submittedAt
FROM exam_attempts a
JOIN exams e ON a.exam_id = e.exam_id
WHERE a.student_id = #{studentId}
AND a.status = 'GRADED'
UNION ALL
SELECT
NULL AS attemptId,
dra.daily_review_attempt_id AS dailyReviewAttemptId,
NULL AS examId,
'오늘의 복습' AS examTitle,
NULL AS attemptType,
'DAILY_REVIEW' AS resultType,
dra.review_date AS resultDate,
dra.total_score AS totalScore,
dra.max_score AS maxScore,
dra.correct_count AS correctCount,
dra.total_question_count AS totalQuestionCount,
dra.submitted_at AS submittedAt
FROM daily_review_attempts dra
WHERE dra.student_id = #{studentId}
AND dra.status = 'GRADED'
) r
WHERE 1 = 1
AND r.resultDate = #{date}
ORDER BY r.resultDate DESC, r.submittedAt DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
SELECT e.exam_date AS resultDate
FROM exam_attempts a
JOIN exams e ON a.exam_id = e.exam_id
WHERE a.student_id = #{studentId}
AND a.status = 'GRADED'
UNION ALL
SELECT dra.review_date AS resultDate
FROM daily_review_attempts dra
WHERE dra.student_id = #{studentId}
AND dra.status = 'GRADED'
) r
WHERE 1 = 1
AND r.resultDate = #{date}

SELECT COALESCE( ROUND( SUM( CASE WHEN growth.completedDate BETWEEN #{periodStart} AND DATE_SUB(#{recentStart}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN growth.totalScore ELSE 0 END ) * 100 / NULLIF( SUM( CASE WHEN growth.completedDate BETWEEN #{periodStart} AND DATE_SUB(#{recentStart}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN growth.maxScore ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) ), 0 ) AS previousAverageScore,
COALESCE( ROUND( SUM( CASE WHEN growth.completedDate BETWEEN #{recentStart} AND #{periodEnd} THEN growth.totalScore ELSE 0 END ) * 100 / NULLIF( SUM( CASE WHEN growth.completedDate BETWEEN #{recentStart} AND #{periodEnd} THEN growth.maxScore ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) ), 0 ) AS recentAverageScore,
COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN growth.completedDate BETWEEN #{periodStart} AND DATE_SUB(#{recentStart}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS previousAttemptCount,
COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN growth.completedDate BETWEEN #{recentStart} AND #{periodEnd} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS recentAttemptCount,
COUNT(*) AS completedAttemptCount, COALESCE(SUM(growth.reviewCorrectCount), 0) AS reviewCorrectCount, COALESCE(SUM(growth.reviewQuestionCount), 0) AS reviewQuestionCount
FROM (
SELECT DATE(a.submitted_at) AS completedDate, a.total_score AS totalScore, a.max_score AS maxScore, CASE WHEN a.attempt_type = 'REVIEW' THEN a.correct_count ELSE 0 END AS reviewCorrectCount, CASE WHEN a.attempt_type = 'REVIEW' THEN a.total_question_count ELSE 0 END AS reviewQuestionCount
FROM exam_attempts a
WHERE a.student_id = #{studentId} AND a.status = 'GRADED' AND DATE(a.submitted_at) BETWEEN #{periodStart} AND #{periodEnd}
UNION ALL
SELECT DATE(dra.submitted_at) AS completedDate, dra.total_score AS totalScore, dra.max_score AS maxScore, dra.correct_count AS reviewCorrectCount, dra.total_question_count AS reviewQuestionCount
FROM daily_review_attempts dra
WHERE dra.student_id = #{studentId} AND dra.status = 'GRADED' AND DATE(dra.submitted_at) BETWEEN #{periodStart} AND #{periodEnd}
) growth

SELECT DISTINCT completedDate
FROM (
SELECT DATE(a.submitted_at) AS completedDate
FROM exam_attempts a
WHERE a.student_id = #{studentId} AND a.status = 'GRADED' AND DATE(a.submitted_at) BETWEEN #{periodStart} AND #{periodEnd}
UNION ALL
SELECT DATE(dra.submitted_at) AS completedDate
FROM daily_review_attempts dra
WHERE dra.student_id = #{studentId} AND dra.status = 'GRADED' AND DATE(dra.submitted_at) BETWEEN #{periodStart} AND #{periodEnd}
) study
ORDER BY completedDate

mapper.select:
SELECT a.answer_id, a.attempt_id, a.question_id, a.student_answer, a.is_correct, a.earned_score,
q.question_id AS q_question_id, q.question_number, q.question_text, q.correct_answer, q.score AS question_score
FROM exam_answers a
JOIN exam_questions q ON a.question_id = q.question_id
WHERE a.attempt_id = #{attemptId}
ORDER BY q.question_number

SELECT DISTINCT q.question_id AS questionId, q.exam_id AS examId, q.section_id AS sectionId, q.question_number AS questionNumber, q.question_type AS questionType, q.question_type_tag AS questionTypeTag, q.score, q.correct_answer AS correctAnswer, q.question_text AS questionText, q.passage, q.sort_order AS sortOrder
FROM exam_answers ea
JOIN exam_attempts a ON ea.attempt_id = a.attempt_id
JOIN exams e ON a.exam_id = e.exam_id
JOIN exam_questions q ON ea.question_id = q.question_id
WHERE a.student_id = #{studentId}
AND a.attempt_type = 'EXAM'
AND a.status = 'GRADED'
AND ea.is_correct = FALSE
AND e.exam_type != 'WORD'
AND e.exam_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 2 DAY) AND CURDATE()
ORDER BY questionId

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ea.question_id)
FROM exam_answers ea
JOIN exam_attempts a ON ea.attempt_id = a.attempt_id
JOIN exams e ON a.exam_id = e.exam_id
WHERE a.student_id = #{studentId}
AND a.attempt_type = 'EXAM'
AND a.status = 'GRADED'
AND ea.is_correct = FALSE
AND e.exam_type != 'WORD'
AND e.exam_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 2 DAY) AND CURDATE()

SELECT daily_review_attempt_id AS dailyReviewAttemptId, student_id AS studentId, review_date AS reviewDate, status, total_score AS totalScore, max_score AS maxScore, correct_count AS correctCount, total_question_count AS totalQuestionCount, started_at AS startedAt, submitted_at AS submittedAt, graded_at AS gradedAt
FROM daily_review_attempts
WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND review_date = CURDATE() AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
ORDER BY daily_review_attempt_id DESC
LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO daily_review_answers ( daily_review_attempt_id, question_id, student_answer, is_correct, earned_score ) VALUES ( #{dailyReviewAttemptId}, #{questionId}, #{studentAnswer}, #{isCorrect}, #{earnedScore} )
